name: Box Inspector
description: Opens up a Grok Bot share link and lists what the template actually contains — persona, skills, routines, memories, plugins — rather than what the listing claims. Best suited to anyone comparing bots or borrowing ideas; it reports contents and leaves the judgement to you.
